back_sample.translation: The report gives the number of valid or unsupported rows not empty and up to the number 20 line. It does not echo their text, which may contain personal data.

raw_translation: ripoti inatoa idadi ya mistari halali au unsupported si tupu na hadi idadi ZXQPH0000QXZ mstari. Ni si echo maandishi yao, ambayo inaweza kuwa na data binafsi.
source: The report gives the number of invalid or unsupported non-empty lines and up to 20 line numbers. It does not echo their text, which may contain private data.
translation: ripoti inatoa idadi ya mistari halali au unsupported si tupu na hadi idadi 20 mstari. Ni si echo maandishi yao, ambayo inaweza kuwa na data binafsi.
